FLASHCARD · LOWERCASE ALPHABET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Letter v Flashcard — the Little Letter v (Van)

Van begins with the big letter V — and this is its little letter v, the shape your child will see most in books. One little letter, all alone, nothing else to look at.

Draw on this card: pick a crayon under the picture, write or color right on the card with a finger, a stylus or the mouse, then tap “Save my work” to keep a copy. Nothing is uploaded anywhere — the drawing stays on your device.

← UmbrellaPrevious cardWhale →Next card

Say it together

“V is for van. Vvv — van! Here comes the van.”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the letter, the word, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Little letters are everywhere — most words in a book are little letters. After the card, open any picture book and let your child be the one who spots a little v.
